title: Centre For Biological Diversity
definition: The Center for Biological Diversity (CBD) is a prominent international non-profit organization focused on protecting endangered species and wild places through science, law, and creative media. In the Indian UPSC context, it serves as a case study for global environmental advocacy, legal activism, and the intersection of biodiversity conservation with climate policy.
importanceInUpsc: UPSC frequently tests the role of NGOs in global environmental governance, the legal mechanisms of the Endangered Species Act (ESA), and the intersection of climate change with habitat loss.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Centre For Biological Diversity.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
